name: UK passport
fullName: UK passport photo for online applications
covers: Online UK passport applications and renewals
intro: GOV.UK accepts a digital photo for online passport applications. It must be at least 600 × 750 pixels and between 50 KB and 10 MB, and HM Passport Office crops it for you.

documents.label: Passport photo
notes: At least 600 × 750 pixels, between 50 KB and 10 MB, in colour and sharp.
Show your head, shoulders and upper body. GOV.UK crops the photo itself, so keep the zoom all the way out.
Plain light background that contrasts with you, nobody else in the photo, no red eye.
Taken within the last month, and not retouched. Only use this tool to fix the file size or format.

source.label: GOV.UK: Get a passport photo, digital photos

faqs.q: What size is a digital UK passport photo?
faqs.a: At least 600 pixels wide and 750 pixels tall, with a file size between 50 KB and 10 MB.

faqs.q: Should I crop my UK passport photo?
faqs.a: No. GOV.UK asks you not to crop it, because HM Passport Office does that. Keep your head, shoulders and upper body in the frame and leave the zoom at its lowest.
